hooks.name: Validate HexAST sandbox, gas limit and data contracts

action.prompt: Audit only the file that was just saved against .kiro/steering/tech.md and hexcard_design_spec.md. Check: 1) No eval(), new Function(), setTimeout/setInterval with a string, or dynamically created <script> elements. 2) If the file is src/core/vm.ts: every statement and expression evaluation path calls ctx.tick(), the budget is 10,000 steps per top-level dispatch shared with nested dispatches, and control flow does not bypass gas accounting. 3) Background field reads/writes use HexCard.bgFieldContents[fieldId] when sharedText is false and HexFieldPart.content when it is true. 4) No AST is written to persisted or exported data; only scriptSource is persisted. 5) AI output is accepted only after astValidator, print, re-parse and deep-equal checks. 6) fetch follows the section 4.3 policy (https only, GET, credentials omit, no custom headers, 8 s timeout, 256 KB cap). Report each violation with its line number. Edit the file only if a violation exists, and change nothing else.
